idea_protein.desc: Wild-type enzymes studied in the paper — the amide-synthesizing enzymes (e.g. AcsA, AsbA, AsbB, DesD, SfaB, DdaG) and the AS-series homolog diversity panel (AS1–AS48). One row per distinct enzyme; engineered variants live in idea_mutant.

cols.id: Stable internal identifier for the enzyme.
cols.name: Enzyme name as used in the paper (e.g. 'AcsA', 'AS9').
cols.aa_sequence: Protein amino-acid sequence (populated for the six named enzymes from UniProt/PDB; AS-panel pending).
cols.structure_url: Link to a 3-D structure (RCSB PDB) — populated for enzymes with a solved structure (e.g. DesD 7TGM).
cols.source_organism: Organism the enzyme derives from (populated for the named enzymes).
cols.created_by: Who/what created the row (audit; here the ETL loader).

idea_mutant.desc: Engineered variants of a parent enzyme (all AS9 here): single point mutants, combinatorial multi-mutants, and the full site-saturation (SSM) panel. The wild-type reference is the one row flagged is_wild_type=true.

cols.id: Stable internal identifier for the variant.
cols.idea_protein_id: The parent enzyme this variant derives from (→ idea_protein).
cols.mutations: Mutation(s) in standard notation, e.g. 'A219M' or 'V213L A215Q'; empty for wild-type.
cols.dna_sequence: Variant coding DNA sequence (not yet populated).
cols.design_method: How the variant was made (site-directed, combinatorial, site-saturation, wild-type).
cols.ai_design_id: Link to an AI/computational design record, if any (→ ai_design).
cols.is_wild_type: True for the wild-type baseline used as the fold-change reference.

idea_reactant.desc: Chemical species — both substrates (diacids, diamines, amino acids) and products (the synthesized amide diads/triads/tetrads, N66 congeners, MAXA-family isomers). One row per distinct chemical as named in the source data.

cols.id: Stable internal identifier for the chemical.
cols.name: Chemical name as used in the paper.
cols.inchi_key: InChIKey (hashed structure id) — populated for the real monomer/substrate chemicals via PubChem.
cols.molecular_formula: Molecular formula — populated for the real monomer/substrate chemicals via PubChem.
cols.molecular_weight: Monoisotopic/observed mass (m/z) — populated for measured products.
cols.notes: Free-text notes, incl. whether the row is a synthesized product.

idea_reaction.desc: A synthesis reaction assayed in the paper — a substrate pair condensing into an amide product, grouped by reaction class (diad / triad / tetrad / MAXA / N66 synthesis).

cols.id: Stable internal identifier for the reaction.
cols.name: Human label, e.g. 'Diad synthesis: Adipic acid and Hexamethylenediamine'.
cols.equation: The substrate pair / reaction description as given in the source.
cols.reaction_type: Reaction class: Diad / Triad / Tetrad / MAXA / N66 synthesis.
cols.notes: Free-text notes (e.g. inferred-substrate or unresolved-code flags).

idea_stoichiometry.desc: Which chemicals participate in a reaction and in what role — the substrate/product membership of each idea_reaction. Negative coefficient = consumed, positive = produced.

idea_strain.desc: Microbial host strains — the E. coli BL21(DE3) expression host; the no-enzyme host-lysate control samples link here.

cols.parent_strain_id: Parent strain, for derived strains (→ idea_strain).

idea_experiment.desc: A logical experiment / assay campaign grouping many samples (e.g. the tetrad-synthesis panels, the AS9 engineering campaign, the Figure-4 substrate scope, a specific plate run).

cols.procedure_id: Link to the lab procedure used (→ idea_procedure).

idea_sample.desc: One assay instance — a single enzyme × substrate reaction measured in one replicate/well. The enzyme is NOT a column here; it is linked via sample_protein (a sample may carry a wild-type enzyme, an engineered mutant, or nothing at all for a no-enzyme control).

cols.name: Human label encoding enzyme|substrate|replicate for readability.
cols.experiment_id: The experiment this sample belongs to (→ idea_experiment).
cols.replicate: Replicate number (1..N) — each source replicate is its own sample row.
cols.sample_type: Assay format: in vitro synthesis assay / cell lysate / purified enzyme.
cols.parent_sample_id: Parent sample, for derived/split samples (→ idea_sample).
cols.storage_location: Plate position or storage note (e.g. 'row C col 1').

idea_measurement.desc: A measurement event on a sample — the instrument readout (mass-spec, LC-MS quantitation, titer assay) that a parameter value came from.

protein_parameter.desc: Enzyme/variant-scoped numeric results — summary values attached to a protein or mutant (e.g. the averaged N66 titer with its standard deviation).

cols.label: What is measured, e.g. 'N66 L1 titer (avg)'.
cols.error: Uncertainty — here the standard deviation of replicates.

protein_comparison.desc: A variant-vs-reference comparison — the fold-change of an engineered variant relative to wild-type (the site-saturation and plate fold-change data live here).

cols.reference_mutant_id: The reference variant, i.e. wild-type (→ idea_mutant).
cols.label: What is compared, e.g. 'fold-change to WT (N66 L1)'.

sample_parameter.desc: Per-sample measured values — the core measurement table. Each row is one number about one sample and, via the analyte link, one specific product: mass-spec intensity, titer (mg/L), or conversion (%). value is text discriminated by value_type (the EAV pattern).

cols.sample_id: The sample this value is about (→ idea_sample).
cols.idea_reactant_id: The analyte/product the value describes (→ idea_reactant) — the key that keeps e.g. MAXA vs XAMA titers in one well unambiguous.
cols.label: What is measured: 'mass-spec intensity', 'titer', 'conversion', 'N66 L1 titer'.
cols.value: The value as text (typed via value_type).

sample_protein.desc: Links a sample to the enzyme it contains — a wild-type protein OR an engineered mutant. A no-enzyme (negative control) sample simply has no row here.

cols.idea_protein_id: The wild-type enzyme, if the sample carries one (→ idea_protein).
cols.idea_mutant_id: The engineered variant, if the sample carries one (→ idea_mutant).

sample_reactant.desc: Links a sample to its substrate chemical(s), with concentration where recorded.

sample_reaction.desc: Links a sample to the reaction(s) it assays; is_primary marks the main reaction of the sample.

cols.is_primary: True if this is the sample's primary reaction.

idea_lab.desc: Labs that generated data. Empty in this release (provenance backbone).

idea_people.desc: People/contacts. Empty in this release (provenance backbone).

idea_protocol.desc: Written protocols. Empty in this release (provenance backbone).

idea_procedure.desc: A protocol applied by a lab at a time. Empty in this release.

ai_design.desc: AI/computational enzyme-design runs. Empty in this release (platform-optional).

computation.desc: Computational predictions/simulations. Empty in this release (platform-optional).

idea_dbxref.desc: Cross-references to external databases — PubChem CIDs for compounds and PDB/UniProt accessions for enzymes.
